name: Sjuhäradsleden, etapp 9: Böne kyrka - Årås säteri
description: Böne kyrka to Årås säteri. Candidate import from normalized research; verify current notices before publication.
waterSources: Varpaledet / Jogen bathing water: Municipal bathing place at Jogen. Havs- och vattenmyndigheten records cited by rules lane listed 2025 samples as tjänligt with no algal bloom, but no 2026 bathing-season samples were found on 2026-04-29. This is not a drinking-water source.
notes: Borås trail page labels the endpoint coordinate Årås säteri, while the official map/PDF, OSM and E1/Naturkartan-adjacent sources commonly label the practical endpoint as Årås kvarn. Årås Säteri & Trädgårdar uses Årås Mill as the start/end for local trails.
Borås and OSM tag the section as 12 km. Naturkartan/Årås/E1 use 11.5 km, and computed Naturkartan/OSM linework is about 11.42-11.44 km.
Naturkartan API has publish_gpx=false, but the public .gpx endpoint returned valid GPX on 2026-04-29.
OSM relation direction tags match official Böne-to-Årås order, but two member ways are stored opposite traversal direction.
A firepit is mapped near Struntfiskeboa, but Årås reserve rules prohibit making fire. The exact reserve boundary and firepit location must be clipped before import.
Current Årås pages list lodging/cafe services, but a 2019 field report found the STF hostel closed in pre-season and the 2026-updated cafe page retained stale season wording.

facilities.name: Böne kyrka
facilities.description: Stage-start church and heritage endpoint. Field report from 2025 says the church was locked and a notice said water was not drinkable, so do not show church access or water as reliable services. Suppress water/toilet/open-church claims unless current parish information confirms them.

facilities.name: Böne kyrka parking and information
facilities.description: Start-side parking/access object at Böne kyrka. Information-board coordinate is inferred to the same trailhead area because Borås confirms the facility but no separate mapped information node was found. Verify on-site parking rules and whether information board is still present.

facilities.name: Varpaledet badplats
facilities.description: Municipal bathing place at Jogen between Kölingared and Liared. Ulricehamn lists dry toilet, jetties, swings, grill place, tables/benches and changing rooms. Treat water as bathing water only, not drinking water. Facility coordinates differ across sources; use municipal/UEAB/OSM cluster and verify exact objects before splitting toilet/grill/changing-room records.

facilities.name: Varpaledet parking
facilities.description: Small parking by Varpaledet/Jogen bathing-place area. OSM tags access=yes, fee=no, parking=surface. No fixed public transport nearby.

facilities.name: Struntfiskeboa vindskydd
facilities.description: Basic shelter near Jogen/Årås. OSM describes two attached shelters, one lean-to side with possible sleeping for two if the table is moved, and one roofed side with benches/tables. A 2025 E1 field report also noted a wind shelter near the Vållern/Årås reserve area. Verify whether the shelter sits inside Årås reserve or other no-fire/no-camping rule area and verify current maintenance/overnight permission before showing as overnight shelter.

facilities.name: Årås parking and information
facilities.description: Endpoint parking/access area at Årås, also used for nearby Årås routes. Länsstyrelsen lists parking and walking-trail service for the reserve. No fixed public transport; reserve parking/camper rules apply.

facilities.name: Årås kvarn / Trädgårdscafé
facilities.description: Seasonal cafe/food service at the Årås endpoint cluster. Årås pages mention cafe/dining, but field-report lane found current opening reliability unclear because the cafe page had stale season text despite a 2026-02-02 update. Do not imply open-now availability; verify current season/hours before publication.

facilities.name: Årås kvarn vandrarhem / Mejeriet
facilities.description: Endpoint lodging/hostel cluster at Årås. Årås pages list accommodation with shared showers/toilets and self-catering kitchen; 2019 Komoot report said the STF hostel was closed in pre-season then, so current booking must be confirmed. Treat water/toilet/shower/kitchen as guest/customer facilities, not public trail utilities.

facilities.name: Varpaledet / Jogen bathing water
facilities.description: Municipal bathing place at Jogen. Havs- och vattenmyndigheten records cited by rules lane listed 2025 samples as tjänligt with no algal bloom, but no 2026 bathing-season samples were found on 2026-04-29. This is not a drinking-water source.
